submitted.rationale: Index 3 (Sb fraction 0.353) had the highest measured EQE, 0.073%. Its neighbours were lower: index 0 (0.280) gave 0.043%, index 4 (0.383) gave 0.055% and index 8 (0.513) gave 0.018%. So the EQE peaks near Sb≈0.35. Its XRD matches the Pb2Sb2O7 pyrochlore best (mp-647374, cosine similarity 0.76), and it probably also contains a Pb-rich second phase.

rejected.reason: Not measured for EQE. EQE fell steadily as Sb rose above 0.35, and its XRD peaks are different from the pyrochlore at index 3
